scientific_integrity: Proof derived from the pointwise operator equality and finite laminar-component normal form; finite checker supplements rather than replaces proof. Historical-priority uncertainty remains, including incomplete access to a 2023 source.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two named agents, finite nonempty S5 frames and all Boolean valuations. No multi-agent, non-S5, algorithmic complexity or asymptotic claims. Classical Bell and integer-partition identities are prior mathematics.
title: Normality and the exact census of two-agent someone-knows frames
